subject: [ACTION REQUIRED] Elevated 5xx/429 surge — credit & remediation negotiation
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@heliopay.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.dev>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya@heliopay.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in 5xx/429s — immediate impact on checkout — asking for credits

Markus,

We saw a large spike in 5xx and 429 responses starting ~2026-06-28 22:15 UTC that persisted with intermittent recovery windows until this morning. Customers experienced timeouts during payment authorization; we estimate ~12% of checkout attempts failed and many retried, which amplified the load.

Attached: heliopay_error_snaps.zip (logs and sample traces).

We need three things from Redwood asap:
- A clear incident timeline (what went wrong)
- A remediation commitment with concrete changes to prevent retry storms
- An initial compensation proposal consistent with Section 6 (SLA credits) of our contract — we expect calculation per the SLA and a proposed credit within 48 hours.

Procurement copied. This outage materially impacted our revenue window for the campaign.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Engineering, HelioPay

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.dev>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@heliopay.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya@heliopay.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.dev>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.dev>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s — immediate impact on checkout — asking for credits

Sanjay — thank you for the heads-up and for the logs. I'm very sorry for the impact here. We're treating this as a Sev-1 and have engineers on the runtime and routing stack investigating.

Immediate steps we took:
- Rolled a targeted routing rule to reduce retry amplification to compatible variants (completed 09:12 PT).
- Temporarily increased capacity in the affected pool to stabilize tail latency (09:25 PT).
- Captured full RPC traces and KV cache metrics (attached by you).

Evelyn & Rishi are looped in for the remediation and credit discussion. To get you a concrete SLA-based credit calculation we need the exact impacted window you want us to use for measurement (your team window vs. our detected window). Can you confirm whether we should align to your campaign hour range (2026-06-28 22:00–2026-06-29 03:00 UTC) or the broader 24-hour window?

I'll follow up with a preliminary credit calc and a mitigation plan within 24 hours.

—Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.dev>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@heliopay.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.dev>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.dev>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s — initial credit proposal and next steps

Sanjay — thanks for forwarding the logs. We ran an initial impact analysis based on the campaign range Markus mentioned (2026-06-28 22:00–2026-06-29 03:00 UTC). Key findings (brief):
- Error rate (5xx+429) peaked at ~18% for the customer-facing checkout route; aggregate token throughput per-second spiked ~4.2x due to retry amplification.
- Our throttling layer misclassified several correlated transient errors as retriable, which increased retries.

Preliminary compensation proposal (subject to final SLA calc):
- Credit = 10% of monthly invoice for June prorated to the impacted window OR a dollar-equivalent cap of $45,000, whichever is lower. (See preliminary_credit_calc.xlsx attached.)

Remediation commitments:
- Immediate: routing rule and throttling adjustments (already deployed).
- Short-term (72h): deploy fix to retry classification logic and add per-customer backpressure thresholds.
- Long-term (30d): KV cache consistency improvements and a new circuit-breaker layer to prevent request amplification under similar patterns.

We propose a joint call tomorrow to align on the outage window and finalize the credit calc. Are you available on 2026-06-30 10:00 PT?

—Evelyn Hart
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@heliopay.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.dev>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.dev>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya@heliopay.com>, procurement@heliopay.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s — initial credit proposal and next steps

Evelyn/Markus — appreciate the quick analysis but 10% (or $45k cap) is not acceptable given the revenue impact. Per our contract (Section 6.2) the SLA calculation should be based on failed transactions at the route-level — that yields ~28% of the campaign revenue lost and under our interpretation equates to a 30% credit for the billing period.

We need either:
- A credit of 30% for the impacted invoice and a firm timeline for the software fix, or
- An alternative cash settlement that is revenue-equivalent.

Also escalating to our CTO to seek exec engagement if we can’t reach agreement quickly. Please confirm by EOD today.

Sanjay
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.dev>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@heliopay.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.dev>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.dev>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.dev>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.dev>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s — escalation and proposed compromise

Sanjay — I understand and again sorry for the impact. I'm escalating this for exec review and proposing the following compromise for faster resolution (to avoid protracted legal / procurement cycles):

Our proposal (final offer pending legal sign-off):
- Credit of 25% of the prorated impacted invoice for June OR a cash-equivalent cap of $75,000 (whichever results in the lower payout to HelioPay).
- One month of free Dedicated capacity (trial) for HelioPay to reduce tail risk during peak campaigns while we complete the fix.
- We will deliver the technical remediation plan (detailed PR and rollout schedule) within 48 hours, with a target fix deploy within 72 hours.

Attaching internal incident postmortem draft (redwood_incident_postmortem.md) and the HubSpot record. If that sounds acceptable, we'll prepare a settlement document and route to DocuSign for signatures.

Sean & Grace: please advise if the proposed cap/credit is approvable at this stage or if you need a CFO sign-off.

—Markus
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@heliopay.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.dev>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya@heliopay.com>, procurement@heliopay.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s — agreed settlement and next steps

Markus / team — thank you. HelioPay accepts a 20% prorated credit for the impacted invoice plus the one-month Dedicated trial and we accept the remediation timeline you proposed (48h plan, 72h fix target). We'll sign the settlement via DocuSign (heliopay_settlement_docusign.pdf attached) and would like weekly syncs to validate the fix until 30 days post-deploy.

Please confirm the DocuSign link and I’ll circulate to procurement and finance for signature. Once signed, we’ll close this ticket and move to validation.

Regards,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Engineering, HelioPay
